---
title: "About MLPerf EDU"
---

MLPerf EDU is a pedagogical ML systems benchmark suite developed alongside the
[Machine Learning Systems](https://mlsysbook.ai) textbook and aligned with
[MLCommons MLPerf](https://mlcommons.org/benchmarks/). It exists because the
official suite, the enterprise gold standard, is too heavy for most classrooms
and academic groups to run, modify, and cite. MLPerf EDU keeps the
methodology and removes the friction.

## Design Philosophy

**White-box algorithms.** Core teaching models are sub-300-line pure
PyTorch modules with no opaque vendor bindings in the measured loop. A student
who wants to see how the KV cache bottlenecks a transformer can read the
dictionary that holds it.

**Canonical provenance.** Workloads map to foundational papers and to their
industrial MLPerf counterparts; each benchmark page states its lineage.

**Introspection over anti-cheating.** In a classroom, draconian anti-cheat
machinery costs more than it protects. The harness instead invests in
telemetry: arithmetic intensity, dataloader stall time, and energy estimates
are captured without breaking execution flow.

**The provenance loop.** Training runs emit a `.provd` artifact hashing the
trained state; inference workloads verify against it. Students experience the
train-then-serve lifecycle with cryptographic receipts.

**Referee/SUT separation.** Optimizations live in isolated
[SUT plugins](guide/sut-plugins.qmd); the measurement harness never changes.

## Profiles as a Contract

`min` proves the installation works. `max` is the comparable suite that
courses, papers, and artifact evaluations should cite. `pro` exposes the
research envelope, including quantization, sparsity, serving, and backend
knobs, in controlled variants so another group can reproduce a comparison.
The [running guide](guide/running.qmd) documents the semantics.

## Single Source of Truth

Every benchmark page on this site is generated from the
[workload registry](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/tree/main/mlperf-edu/registry),
the same YAML the harness executes. The CLI reference is generated from the
CLI's own help output. A CI gate fails when documentation and registry drift.
There is no hand-maintained copy of any benchmark fact.

## Status and Governance

MLPerf EDU is developed in public in the
[cs249r_book repository](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book). The
public-result rules, dataset release reviews, quality-target reviews, and the
MLCommons endorsement path live as governance documents in the repository.
Feedback and issues are welcome on the
[issue tracker](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/issues).

## Citing

The companion paper, *MLPerf EDU: Bridging Industry Benchmarking and ML
Systems Education*, lives in the repository under
[`paper/`](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/tree/main/mlperf-edu/paper).
A citable archival reference will accompany the certified release.
